idea: Numbers & counting (Friday school readiness, long 2:30 learning song) at GRANDMA'S FARM (OUTDOOR outfit): a little orange pumpkin pops up onto the hay bale right beside Baby Jimmy ('Pop! Wow! Look! A little pumpkin!'); chorus 'One, two, three, four, five! Little pumpkins in a line! … Count with me – you're doing fine!'; each verse a new pumpkin pops onto the hay bale and he counts up – one (nod), two (clap two times), three (tap knees three times), four (stomp four times), five (show five fingers); clap break; review 'Let's count them all! One, two, three, four, five! How many pumpkins? Hmm?' (2 s pause) – 'Five! Five little pumpkins! Yay!'; loop: the hook framing with the pumpkin, bye-bye wave, more pumpkins tumble in.
title: Wow! A Little Pumpkin! 🎃 Count to 5 with Baby Jimmy | Nursery Rhymes & Kids Songs | Crayon Babies
description:
Pop! A little orange pumpkin bounces right up beside Baby Jimmy! 🎃 Sing along with Baby Jimmy at Grandma's farm and count from one to five as a new pumpkin pops onto the hay bale in every verse.

🎬 What happens in this video:
😮 "Pop! Wow! Look! A little pumpkin!"
1️⃣ One little pumpkin – nod one time with Jimmy!
2️⃣ Two little pumpkins – clap two times!
3️⃣ Three little pumpkins – tap your knees three times!
4️⃣ Four little pumpkins – stomp four times!
5️⃣ Five little pumpkins – show me five fingers!
👏 Clap break – clap, clap, clap your hands with Jimmy!
🤔 "How many pumpkins?" – can you count them?
👋 Bye bye, friends! Bye bye, pumpkins!

📚 Kids learn: counting from 1 to 5 • numbers one, two, three, four, five • counting real objects one by one • English words: pumpkin, round, orange, farm, clap, stomp

🎶 Voices only: children singing, humming and clapping with a soft hand drum – no other musical instruments.

🎵 Lyrics (chorus):
One, two, three, four, five!
Little pumpkins in a line!
One, two, three, four, five!
Count with me – you're doing fine!

A fun sing-along counting song for toddlers and preschoolers – count the little orange pumpkins from one to five with Baby Jimmy at Grandma's farm, then nod, clap, tap, stomp and wiggle your fingers along. A cappella children's song with voices, claps and a hand drum.

Kids songs • Nursery rhymes • Counting song • Numbers song for kids • Count to 5 • Learn numbers for toddlers • Learn English for kids • Toddler learning • Preschool learning • Kids cartoon • Sing-along songs
